meta.title: LockVFX — visual effects for film, series and advertising
meta.description: LockVFX — visual effects for film, series and advertising: compositing, CGI, environments, cleanup and finishing. The name under which [Name] and [Name] work together.

reel.h1: LockVFX — visual effects for film, series and advertising

statement.phrase: We give shape to the images a film imagines and cannot shoot.
statement.paragraph: LockVFX is the name under which [Name] and [Name] work together: compositing, CGI, environments, cleanup, simulation and finishing for film, series and advertising — with a network of studios and specialists that changes with each project.

errors.name: What should we call you?
errors.email: We need an email to reply to.
errors.message: Two lines are enough: project, timing, what you need.

consent.after: and understand my data will be used only to reply to me.

status.sent: Got it. We’ll get back to you within two working days.
status.failed: It didn’t go through. Try again, or write to us directly:

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.short: We use what you send us (name, email, message) only to reply. No newsletter, no sharing with third parties. We keep it for 24 months after our last exchange, then delete it. Your message is delivered to our inboxes through EmailJS. You can ask us to access or delete your data at any time at {{email}}. Full details in the privacy notice.
privacy.body: The full privacy notice is being prepared and will be published here before the site goes live.

legal.collective: LockVFX is the collective name under which {{a}} and {{b}} present their work. It is not a company: each of them works with their own VAT number and in their own name.

chi.h1: Visual effects for film, series and advertising.
chi.lead: LockVFX is the shared name [Name 1] and [Name 2] work under: from a single shot cleanup to a sequence built from scratch, held to the same standard.

servizi.intro: A full service, or just the piece missing from your pipeline.

compositing.title: Compositing
compositing.body: Element integration, keying and roto, 2D/3D tracking, shot-by-shot grading.

cgi.title: 3D and CGI
cgi.body: Modeling, look development, lighting and rendering of assets and environments integrated into the plate.

matte.title: Matte painting and environments
matte.body: Set extensions, skies, landscapes and cities: the ones that don’t exist, or do but not quite like that.

cleanup.title: Cleanup and removals
cleanup.body: Wires, rigs, logos, reflections, anything that shouldn’t be in frame: gone without a trace.

sim.title: Simulations
sim.body: Fire, smoke, water, destruction, particles and cloth, scaled to the shot.

finishing.title: Finishing
finishing.body: Conform, quality control, delivery in the formats post and distributors need.

step1.title: Brief and breakdown
step1.body: We read the script or the cut, count the shots, and say what post needs and what shooting can save.

step2.title: On set, if needed
step2.body: VFX supervision, references, HDRIs, measurements: whatever makes post shorter.

step3.title: Post and revisions
step3.body: Numbered versions, notes in one place, timelines agreed before we start.

step4.title: Delivery
step4.body: In post’s formats, with separate passes if you need them.

persone.placeholder: [Role · city · two lines on what they do and for how long]
persone.transparency: Two freelancers with separate VAT numbers, working together and with others: LockVFX isn’t a company.

contatti.paragraph: A project, a sequence, a doubt about what’s possible: get in touch.
